place.name: Mossgate Common
place.description: A small orchard hamlet green off the Tansyhook lane. A low slate-roofed reading house stands beside a public well; beyond the green is an enclosed practice yard with sand and training posts, and farther downwind are fenced beast-handling pens with water troughs.
place.culture: An ordinary Asterwyn Orchard Vales hamlet serving orchard families, young learners, seasonal workers and licensed animal handlers. Buildings and paddocks are visible from public lanes; access, instruction, and beast welfare remain the responsibility of their actual caretakers.
place.note: Known descriptions and associations are not proof that a person is physically present, agrees to speak, has a resource or belongs to a group.
